Identify the main idea of the following article:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agriculture
description: The main idea of the article is that agriculture is the science and art of cultivating plants and animals for food, fiber, and other products used to sustain life. It includes the cultivation of crops, raising livestock and forestry, as well as the management of soil, water, and plants in order to provide food and energy, maintain a healthy environment, and reduce pollution.
